purpose: Combat BiS residual pack for ACCESSORIES, Archaeology combat RELICS, and pocket/utility support not yet first-class in data/research/regional-combat-unlocks.json. Covers Essence of Finality component chain, Reaper/Souls neck residual, Cinderbanes + Erethdor grimoire (Tirannwn), Nightmare gauntlets residual, EGWD/Sanctum combat scriptures, missing combat Archaeology relics (Font of Life, Fury of the Small, Conservation of Energy), and War's Retreat combat hub residual. Skips ring of vigour / adrenaline urn (already present), Soul Split as a global prayer-book claim, FSOA weapon path (out of accessory scope), and Blessing of Het (already skilling desert:blessing-of-het-relic).

policy.region_rule: required_regions means every listed elective region contributes a mandatory base-game acquisition step. region_hints lists support pressure. Never invent multi-region/cross-region/global tokens in region fields.
policy.hard_gate_rule: Only use region_requirement_type all_required when every listed region is truly mandatory for self-supply. Global shop currency (reaper points) is not a second elective region.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed PRESENT in regional-combat-unlocks — do not re-emit: dungeoneering:ring-of-vigour-passive, morytania:berserkers-fury-relic, morytania:heightened-senses-relic, cross-region:death-ward-relic, salve-amulet:enchanted, morytania:amulet-of-forsaken-berserkers-fury, cross-region:igneous-zuk-capes, broken-home:asylum-surgeons-ring, rum-deal:holy-wrench, dungeoneering prayer necklaces, farm perks.
policy.skilling_overlap_rule: misthalin:wars-blessing / wars-grimoire / wars-retreat-skilling-hub already live in regional-skilling. Combat pack emits only combat-facing residual ids (not prayer-switch skilling densify).
policy.scripture_combat_rule: Jas/Wen/Ful/Amascut combat passives enter combat catalog. Bik/Elidinis stay skilling (already first-class).
policy.external_area_rule: Freneskae Nightmares package under Kandarin (user rule 2026-07-26; World Gate / Eagles Peak packaging).
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman self-supply framing only. Do not invent drop rates, DPS averages, or GE prices as planner requirements.
policy.skip_present_adrenaline: Ring of vigour passive already first-class. Adrenaline urn not re-emitted (user skip present).
